body: Email from Rensselaer Newman Foundation Ignite Your Faith and Make a Difference This Pentecost Sunday!   "I would suggest to others to donate to RNF for the same reason I do, to ensure that there is a Catholic presence on the RPI campus, available to the community as needed and to assist with educating the whole student outside of formal classroom instruction." Daniel Horvath, RPI ‘08 Ignite the Spirit on Catholic Day of Giving Tomorrow is Pentecost Sunday — the "birthday" of the Church! It marks the moment the Holy Spirit descended upon the disciples, empowering them to carry Christ’s message to the world. It also marks the beginning of the Church’s mission — a mission that continues today. In that same spirit, tomorrow is RNF Catholic Day of Giving — your opportunity to support the Catholic Ministry at RPI that brings students, alumni, and our parish family closer to Christ. This Pentecost season, we invite you to join in supporting the mission of The Rensselaer Newman Foundation. Your gift helps ensure that the light of faith continues to shine brightly in the lives of all those we serve. MAKE YOUR GIFT EARLY! - DONATE TODAY Please join us in building a legacy of faith, service, and community—right here at RPI. Thanks to the following generous donors, your gift will be matched dollar-for-dollar up to $4,500: Brian McManus, RPI ‘61 Judge Arthur Gajarsa, RPI ’62, and Melanie Gajarsa Michael J. McCabe, RPI ‘79 Anonymous Donor Some exciting news: One of our original matching gift donors has been so inspired by the response that they’ve increased their match by an additional $500! This means your gift today goes even further to support Catholic life at RPI. Don't wait. Double the impact of your gift today! Thanks to other supporters, we've raised more than $2,800 so far! MAKE YOUR GIFT EARLY! - DONATE BELOW If you’ve already given, please disregard this message — and thank you for your early support in helping us reach our matching goal! "Newman is an important space for me to connect with friends from different majors and backgrounds. Without this organization, I wouldn’t have met some of the friends I now consider to be some of my closest connections, people I consider to be friends for life. Your contributions allow us to give our RPI students and members a chance to connect over dinners or events around the Troy area!" body: Email from Rensselaer Newman Foundation Together We Can Strengthen Faith on Campus - Join Us This Sunday! The Christ Sun of Justice Parish has been my spiritual home for all four years I have been at RPI. I’ve truly enjoyed being able to help at Mass, and the great community we have, and I’ve grown in my faith as a result of my involvement. None of that wou﻿ld be possible without support through the Rensselaer Newman Foundation.                              Joseph Bowers, RPI ‘25 Ignite the Spirit on Catholic Day of Giving – Sunday, June 8 This Sunday, we celebrate Pentecost - the descent of the Holy Spirit and the birth of the Church’s mission - and we invite you to be a part of that mission right here at RPI. On Pentecost Sunday, you can help the Rensselaer Newman Foundation raise $10,000 during Catholic Day of Giving at RPI to strengthen and expand the Catholic presence on campus. Your gift will help sustain and upgrade the Chapel + Cultural Center, Christ Sun of Justice Parish, the Catholic Chaplaincy, and the countless ways we accompany students and community members in faith. Thanks to a group of generous supporters, every gift made to the RNF Catholic Day of Giving will be matched dollar-for-dollar, up to $4,000!   Thanks to donors who have already made their gifts, we've raised $1,600 so far!   Let’s keep the momentum going — don’t let this matching opportunity go unclaimed!   If you’ve already given, please disregard this message — and thank you for your early support!   Help us get off to a strong start and double the impact of your gift today! MAKE YOUR GIFT EARLY! - DONATE BELOW Join us in building a legacy of faith, service, and community—right here at RPI.   Newman, though dinners, service opportunities, and group prayer, connects students with their faith while providing them with a much-needed community in faith during their time at RPI. body: Email from Rensselaer Newman Foundation Together We Can Strengthen Faith on Campus - Join Us This Sunday! The Christ Sun of Justice Parish has been my spiritual home for all four years I have been at RPI. I’ve truly enjoyed being able to help at Mass, and the great community we have, and I’ve grown in my faith as a result of my involvement. None of that wou﻿ld be possible without support through the Rensselaer Newman Foundation.                              Joseph Bowers, RPI ‘25 Ignite the Spirit on Catholic Day of Giving – Sunday, June 8 This Sunday, we celebrate Pentecost - the descent of the Holy Spirit and the birth of the Church’s mission - and we invite you to be a part of that mission right here at RPI. On Pentecost Sunday, you can help the Rensselaer Newman Foundation raise $10,000 during Catholic Day of Giving at RPI to strengthen and expand the Catholic presence on campus. Your gift will help sustain and upgrade the Chapel + Cultural Center, Christ Sun of Justice parish, the Catholic Chaplaincy, and the countless ways we accompany students and community members in faith. Thanks to a group of generous supporters, when you support Catholic Day of Giving, it will be matched dollar-for-dollar up to $4,000! Help us get off to a strong start!! MAKE YOUR GIFT EARLY! - DONATE BELOW Join us in building a legacy of faith, service, and community—right here at RPI.   Thank you in advance for your support!   My Catholic Faith is a very important part of who I am as a person.
